constraints.constraint: The image must contain a sink.
constraints.A_evidence: An inset basin is visible at the right side of the vanity countertop.
constraints.B_evidence: A vessel basin sits beneath a faucet.

constraints.constraint: The sink unit must be wooden.
constraints.A_evidence: The vanity cabinet and legs have clearly visible natural wood grain.
constraints.B_evidence: The stand has an opaque glossy black finish; its underlying material is not visibly identifiable.

constraints.constraint: The sink unit must have a black marble surface.
constraints.A_evidence: The countertop surrounding the inset basin is black stone with pale marble veining.
constraints.B_evidence: The basin rests on a thin glossy black glass-like tabletop, without a marble surface; the visible veined stone is on the wall.

judgment.reason: A shows a wooden sink vanity topped with black veined marble. B has a glossy black tabletop rather than the required black marble surface.
